about: G3 for #896 task 7: every group of cards whose grammar-only derive differs from the stored derive, labelled. Keys are instruments/src/grammar-only.ts's group keys. Labels: grammar right / grammar wrong / both wrong. The switch waits until every group is labelled and no 'grammar wrong' group is left.

abilities:1->2.label: grammar right
abilities:1->2.why: The grammar reads what the store folded or left out: a copy's 'except it has this ability' (Thespian's Stage), '~ and Drakes you control each get' as the card and the class (Alandra, Sky Dreamer), a self cost reduction (March of Swirling Mist).

abilities:2->3.label: grammar right
abilities:2->3.why: One grant per keyword where the store wrote the whole sentence as one unread grant (Lorehold Command: indestructible and haste).

abilities:2->1.label: grammar right
abilities:2->1.why: The store's phantom action: an intervening 'if you cast it' recorded as a cast (Sunderflock, The Sibsig Ceremony).

abilities:3->2.label: grammar right
abilities:3->2.why: The store's phantom actions again (The Sibsig Ceremony's cast, Quick Draw's pump of the opponent's creatures, which the card does not print).

emits.subject(~control).label: grammar right
emits.subject(~control).why: A player action with no object is yours: investigate's Clue, manifest dread's creature, a returned Reassembling Skeleton (the store's 'any').

effect.subject(+counter).label: grammar right
effect.subject(+counter).why: The counter's kind reaches the effect subject ('oil counter' on Mindsplice Apparatus); the store wrote the bare kind on some cards and 'charge counter' on others.

emits.subject(+fromZone).label: grammar right
emits.subject(+fromZone).why: An exile of a permanent named outright leaves the battlefield (Anguished Unmaking, Deadly Rollick); the store wrote the zone for some exiles and not others.

abilities:0->1.label: grammar right
abilities:0->1.why: What the store recorded as nothing: Snuff Out's 4 life paid, Ashling's evoke grant, Whirler Rogue's tapped artifacts as a cost.

emits.subject(+type).label: grammar right
emits.subject(+type).why: The card itself with its type: 'sacrifice this land', 'untap this artifact' where the store wrote 'this' (Evolving Wilds, Bender's Waterskin).

amount.label: grammar right
amount.why: The count the words state: the card exiling or sacrificing itself is 1 (Reunion of the House, Temporal Mastery, Piru), 'the top two cards' 2; the store left these amounts off. Lorehold Charm's store grant read 'creatures you control' as the granted ability.

effect.subject(~control),emits.subject(~.label: grammar right
effect.subject(~control),emits.subject(~.why: You proliferate (Yawgmoth, Cacophony Scamp, Evolution Sage); the store wrote 'any' or nothing.

abilities:1->3.label: grammar right
abilities:1->3.why: A copy's exceptions read as grants (Machine God's Effigy: 'except it's an artifact and it has {T}: Add {U}'); a grant list split per ability (Swashbuckler's Whip).

repeats.label: grammar right
repeats.why: A phase trigger on ANYONE's step ('each upkeep', 'each combat', 'the end step', 'each player's draw step') fires every turn (per-turn); the store wrote control 'you' and so per-cycle. Unnatural Growth, Howling Mine, Ophiomancer, Sting, The Gaffer, Hermit of the Natterknolls. 'combat on your turn' and 'your upkeep' stay per-cycle (phaseControl).

effect.subject(+self +type).label: grammar right
effect.subject(+self +type).why: A spell's own cost reduction ('This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control a Wizard', Arcane Epiphany, Into the Story, Explosive Singularity) keeps its whole phrase, so derive marks the reduction as the spell's own (self, type spell); the store's '{1} less to cast' left the subject blank.

amount,count.label: grammar right
amount,count.why: Same as 'amount': 'the top five cards of your library' 5 (Escape to the Wilds), 'an additional land' 1 (Explore, Ghirapur Orrery), 'X mana of any one color' X (Axebane Guardian). The store writes these on some cards and not others (Sword of Forge and Frontier has them).

trigger.label: grammar right
trigger.why: The store hangs a mid-sentence delayed trigger on the whole clause ('Exile ... Return those cards ... at the beginning of the next end step', Eerie Interlude, Ghostway, Blood Frenzy), timing the exile or pump at the end step too; the grammar leaves the clause untimed. Kicker conditions are no trigger (Protect the Negotiators).

repeats,trigger.label: grammar right
repeats,trigger.why: 'When you do' is a reflexive trigger (Watchful Naga, Bolg of the North, Ruthless Lawbringer, Sorin): the store resolved it to its antecedent's event ('sacrifice', 'exert', 'discard'), which made the card a consumer of every such event in the deck; it fires only on its own optional cost.

emits.subject(-ref +self).label: grammar right
emits.subject(-ref +self).why: 'When this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice it' (Phantasmal Dreadmaw), 'When this land enters, sacrifice it unless you pay {1}' (Gateway Plaza): the 'it' of a self trigger is the card itself; the store left it a back-reference to the trigger.

count,emits.subject(+fromZone).label: grammar right
count,emits.subject(+fromZone).why: As 'emits.subject(+fromZone)': an exile of permanents named outright ('Exile all creatures', Farewell; 'exile all other permanents you control', Worldgorger Dragon; 'exile all attacking creatures', Angel of the Dire Hour) leaves the battlefield.

trigger.batched.label: grammar right
trigger.batched.why: 'Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard' (Soul Enervation), 'one or more counters are put on' (Danny Pink), 'one or more artifact cards leave' (Imotekh): a batched trigger, once per event however many objects; the store left it unbatched.

emits.subject(~control +scope).label: grammar right
emits.subject(~control +scope).why: The object is the target the sentence named: Lava Coil's and Fanged Flames' 'exile it instead' is the targeted creature (an opponent's, as derive reads a removal target), Archon of Cruelty's discard is the target opponent's; the store wrote the player or 'that creature' with no scope.

grants.label: grammar right
grants.why: The grant names its keywords ('this creature gets +1/+1 and has flying and trample', Dragonloft Idol; 'has first strike', Prickleboar; 'has trample', Wayward Angel); the store wrote the recipient as the object and lost which keyword.

abilities:3->4.label: grammar right
abilities:3->4.why: The grammar reads a step the store folded: a search's put as its own move (Urza's Cave, Magda), a pump's keyword as its own grant (Invasion of Mercadia), Necromancy's quoted enchant grant. lostClaims keeps any card where the split would drop a kind or emit.

abilities:2->4.label: grammar right
abilities:2->4.why: One action per recipient ('2 damage to each opponent and each creature they control', Delayed Blast Fireball), an animation's P/T and keywords apart from the animation (Gideon, Martial Paragon; Ebony Fly), a pile exiled from two zones (Triumph of Saint Katherine).

abilities:1->0.label: grammar wrong
abilities:1->0.why: The grammar drops an ability the store keeps: a Station level's '7+ | Flying' and keyword lines as no grant, 'loses all creature types' read as a can't (Amoeboid Changeling), the zone of a card copied from a graveyard (Superior Spider-Man). Fixed in this round: Cactuar's 'return it'. A flash grant to spells (Alchemist's Refuge) was tried and dropped: the reading reached the stored path too and stripped Quicksilver's recipient.

emits.subject(-fromZone).label: grammar wrong
emits.subject(-fromZone).why: Where the moved card comes from, which the grammar does not infer yet: 'exile it' of a target creature (Gossip's Talent), a creature card put from a revealed hand (Treacherous Urge), 'return that creature' after a delayed trigger. 30 of the 49 were fixed in this round ('the exiled card', a self exile, 'target creature that player controls', a revealed top card).

effect.subject(~control).label: grammar right
effect.subject(~control).why: The library scried or surveilled is yours either way (the store's 'your library' and the grammar's '1' give the same emit), and a tutor's 'put that card on top' is on top of YOUR library, which the grammar now writes (Enlightened Tutor, Mystical Tutor).

abilities:0->1,abilities:1->0.label: grammar right
abilities:0->1,abilities:1->0.why: Only the clause id of an or-trigger's second event differs: the store numbered it 2.1, 100, 1000 or a duplicate 3 (Vengeful Ancestor, Sedgemoor Witch, Veyran, Warped Tusker); the grammar numbers it after the last clause, the store's usual form. Sub-ids were measured and refused (-175 identical).

effect.kind.label: both wrong
effect.kind.why: A colour or land-type change ('becomes blue', 'are Mountains', 'are snow') is read as an animation by the grammar and as a pump or grant by the store; neither is right (measured a third reading, refused, round 2). The copy-exception type grants in this group are grammar right.

unless.label: grammar right
unless.why: The grammar keeps the whole payment ('{2} for each creature they control that's attacking you', Windborn Muse), keeps a payment the store dropped (Awesome Presence), and names the payer: 'that player' is the opponent (Rhystic Study), 'you' is you (The Tabernacle's granted upkeep).

emits.label: both wrong
emits.why: Mixed: the grammar is right on Talon Gates' phase-out (the store wrote put) and Divine Gambit's zone, wrong on 'sacrifice it' after a cost on this enchantment (Quest for the Holy Relic), Immortal Coil's 'for each' tail, Toshiro's exiled spell. Kept on the store until split.

amount,count,effect.scaling.label: grammar right
amount,count,effect.scaling.why: An X the sentence defines ('X mana of any one color, where X is this creature's power', Heronblade Elite, Kami of Whispered Hopes, Selvala) is no X paid; the store's amount X made derive read it as an X spell (x-cost scaling). A paid X ('Exile the top X cards', Zenith Festival) keeps it.

emits.subject(-type).label: both wrong
emits.subject(-type).why: Adapt and monstrosity put counters on the card itself: the grammar's untyped self is the #956 direction and right; but bolster's counter-added loses 'creature' (Dromoka's Gift), and a revealed land card (Galadriel) and a doubled combat damage (Inquisitor's Flail) lose their words. Kept on the store until split; 'creature' for bolster was measured and refused (-13 identical).

effect.subject(-counter).label: grammar wrong
effect.subject(-counter).why: A self counter written bare ('+1/+1', the store's majority form) gives derive no counter on the effect subject, where the store's '+1/+1 counter' on these cards did (Ob Nixilis, the Fallen; Geralf; Korvold). Writing every kind as 'X counter' was measured and refused (-717 identical).

abilities:0->1,abilities:4->2.label: grammar right
abilities:0->1,abilities:4->2.why: An 'enters or attacks' trigger's second event: the store gave both records the SAME id (2 and 2, 3 and 3: Threefold Thunderhulk, Ultron, Kroxa and Kunoros), so one branch's actions were lost to the id; the grammar numbers the second event after the last clause and keeps both.

abilities:2->0.label: grammar right
abilities:2->0.why: A keyword line ('Trample; rampage 2', Gorilla Berserkers) and a Station level ('8+ | Flying, trample', Atmospheric Greenhouse) are the card's own keywords, which the store records as no action on every other keyword line; here it wrote grants to the card itself.

effect.subject(-scope).label: grammar wrong
effect.subject(-scope).why: 'that creature' after a target (Vayne's Treachery, Candy Grapple) stays a back-reference where the store wrote 'target creature'; resolving it was measured and refused (-48 identical, the store keeps 'that creature' elsewhere). Set-life and extra-turn players were fixed in this round.

abilities:4->3.label: both wrong
abilities:4->3.why: Mixed: the grammar is right to read 'other creatures you control gain vigilance and menace' as two grants (Pyrewood Gearhulk) and the copy's 'isn't legendary' (Auton Soldier); wrong to fold 'a Zombie card and a Swamp card' into one search (Corpse Harvester) and Dyadrine's two counter removals into one.

effect.subject(-scope -type),emits.subje.label: grammar wrong
effect.subject(-scope -type),emits.subje.why: 'Each creature deals damage to itself equal to its power' (Solar Blaze, Justice Strike, Wisecrack): the recipient is the dealer, which the grammar leaves as 'itself' and the store names.

emits.subject(-scope).label: grammar wrong
emits.subject(-scope).why: A player named through a back-reference ('Its controller may draw', Arcane Denial; 'two target players exchange life totals', Soul Conduit) loses its target scope; 'its controller' as the object was measured and refused (-83 identical).

emits.subject(~control -scope).label: grammar wrong
emits.subject(~control -scope).why: A target player's hand, graveyard or library as 'their' (fixed this round: 'target player exiles a card from their graveyard' now names the player); left: a connive or grant whose target is named only in the clause before (Doctor Doom's 'target Villain you control').

effect.scaling.label: grammar wrong
effect.scaling.why: An X paid in a cost ('Exile X artifact cards from your graveyard', Winter, Cursed Rider; 'Sacrifice X Goats', Springjack Pasture) is the ability's X; the grammar's records leave derive no x-cost scaling where the store's did.

effect.subject(-scope),emits.subject(-sc.label: grammar wrong
effect.subject(-scope),emits.subject(-sc.why: 'Untap that creature' after 'Target creature gets +3/+3' (Seedcradle Witch) and 'deals 10 damage to that player' after a target player in a condition (Hidetsugu's Second Rite) stay back-references; resolving 'that creature' / 'that player' was measured and refused (-48 identical).

emits.subject(-self).label: grammar wrong
emits.subject(-self).why: 'sacrifice it' after a cost that names this land (Sandstone Needle, Peat Bog) and 'blight 1' (Sinister Gnarlbark) lose the card itself; the store wrote 'this'.

emits.subject(~control -ref +scope +type.label: grammar right
emits.subject(~control -ref +scope +type.why: 'attach it to target creature you control' (Bladed Battle-Fan, Cliffhaven Kitesail, Hookblade): the grammar keeps the target the Equipment is attached to; the store wrote only 'it'.

emits.subject(-scope -type).label: grammar wrong
emits.subject(-scope -type).why: 'Goad them' after 'Up to three target creatures can't block' (Coronation of Chaos) and 'shuffle it' after a target (Ice Magic): the target is the subject of an earlier can't, which the records do not carry.

effect.subject(-type).label: grammar wrong
effect.subject(-type).why: 'its controller mills three cards' (Chronic Flooding), 'Its controller draws two cards' (Ob Nixilis, the Hate-Twisted): a player named by 'its' keeps the printed count as the object, so derive loses whose; 'its controller' as the object was measured and refused (-83 identical).

abilities:1->4.label: grammar right
abilities:1->4.why: One action per part: 'destroy up to one target artifact, up to one target creature, up to one target enchantment, and up to one target planeswalker' (Urgent Necropsy), an animation's keywords (Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker; Hive of the Eye Tyrant), a token's keywords (Rite of the Raging Storm).

effect.kind,effect.subject(+control +zon.label: grammar right
effect.kind,effect.subject(+control +zon.why: 'Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, exile it' (Nightmare Shepherd, Hofri Ghostforge), 'Whenever another card is put into a graveyard, exile that card' (Planar Void): from the graveyard; the store left the zone off or wrote the battlefield.

amount,count,effect.kind,effect.subject(.label: grammar right
amount,count,effect.kind,effect.subject(.why: As 'amount,count': 'an additional land' 1 (Kiora, Urban Evolution), 'the next 3 damage' 3 (Healing Grace, Candles' Glow).

emits.subject(+scope).label: grammar right
emits.subject(+scope).why: The object names its scope: 'Each player puts a creature card from their graveyard' is from EACH player's graveyard (Exhume, Show and Tell), 'exile it instead' after 'deals 2 damage to each creature' is each such creature (Crush the Weak, Gallifrey Falls), 'that creature' after a target is that target (Debt of Loyalty).

effect.kind,effect.subject(+subtype ~zon.label: grammar wrong
effect.kind,effect.subject(+subtype ~zon.why: 'When this Aura is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return it to its owner's hand' (Rancor, Despondency, Fortitude): the grammar names the card but not the graveyard it returns from. Writing the graveyard was measured and refused: it also made a dies-trigger 'put it on the bottom of its owner's library' (Murderous Rider) a recursion, and linked discard outlets to a return that only fires from the battlefield (Spine of Ish Sah).

amount,count,effect.kind,effect.subject(.label: grammar right
amount,count,effect.kind,effect.subject(.why: A TYPED ONE-CARD LOOK (#1302): "look at the top card of your library. If it's a Zombie card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't, you may put it into your graveyard". Both readings now derive the typed dig (`search` + `toHand`, derive 385); they differ on the graveyard half, where the stored model answer types the MILL emit by the revealed card's class ("mills a creature", from the condition) and the grammar reads it as the untyped card it is (Territory Culler, Sarinth Steelseeker, Traveling Botanist, Archghoul of Thraben, Bison Whistle, whose grammar also keeps the Bison subtype on its `enters`). These cards were on the grammar reading before the dig was typed (group abilities:1->2); the new keys keep them there. CEILING: these keys pair the two readings' abilities by SORT ORDER, so they are fragile; a change to the sort would flip only the type of the mill emit between the readings, never a role.

effect.subject(+allTypes +stats +subtype.label: grammar right
effect.subject(+allTypes +stats +subtype.why: An ARTIFACT'S SELF-ANIMATE the store left at {type: artifact}: the grammar reads the whole result, "{3}: This artifact becomes a 2/2 Beast artifact creature" (Darksteel Brute), Eye of Malcator, Jade Idol, Mimic, Stalking Stones, and a target artifact's "0/0 Construct artifact creature" (Lifecraft Awakening): type [creature, artifact], the subtype and the P/T. Measured 2026-10-26 (#1352): the grammar's animate now carries the becomes-phrase the way the stored model answer writes it ("this as a 3/6 Golem artifact creature"), so the group is gains only (no field of the stored subject is lost: lostSubjectFields guards that on every card). Every card's oracle text read.
